tei:div.tei:p: ))༄༅// zab lam rta mgrin snying thig snying po don sbyor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs gter 'byung dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

snang srid dbang bsgyur pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje lta bu'i sku// gzi brjid stobs ldan pad+ma dbang gi rgyal// rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ spros bral bde chen rgyal ba kun tu bzang*// rigs kun bdag nyid drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// thugs rje mkha' khyab rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs// sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rje dang*// man ngag bdud rtsi'i mdzod rdol shrī seng*// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku grub pad+ma 'byung*// rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i srol 'dzin mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal// mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal ma// lta ba'i klong rdol chos kyi blo gros sogs// gang zag snyan brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs// lta ba'i gdeng ldan sgom pa'i rtsal rdzogs shing*// spyod pa ro snyoms chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// mchog ldan rdo rje jo mo sgrol ma sogs// las 'phro gter brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs// las smon shugs las grub pa'i lhur len cing*// zab lam chos kyi man ngag ster mdzad pa// sgom pa'i rnal 'byor bsam gtan rdo rje sogs// bka' babs lung thob bla mar gsol ba 'debs// ma nor lam ston zab lam snying thig dang*// snang stong zung 'jug pad+ma he ru ka /drag 'tshubs rol pa'i ma mo sngags srung sogs// grol lam brgyud par bcas la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab pas// long med mi rtag snying nas dran pa dang*// dgos med rtogs nas dben pa'i ri 'grim zhing*// rtogs pas bdag grol thugs rjes gzhan grol nas// rten 'brel thabs mkhas 'brel tshad don ldan shog / ces zab lam snying po don sbyor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang*/

ma mo sngags srung rgyal mo dur khrod ro la spyod ma zhes pas ched du bskul ba la brten nas/ rnal 'byor pa stag sham rdo rjes tsit+ta rin po che'i sgrub sder tshes bzang rta bdun gyi rgyal po shar skabs su sbyar ba 'dis kyang bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar la yun ring du gnas shing smin grol gnyis kyi don dang ldan cing bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs par gyur cig / ༁ྃ: pad+ma yongs grol chos kyi tshan ka che'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// de yang chu mo glang gi lo ston zla dang po'i tshes bcu la: yar thang shel gyi yang rdzong la: jo mo mtsho rgyal bdag 'dra yis: tshogs 'khor mchod pa rgya cher phul nas zhus pa: e ma gu ru rin po che: sems can 'du shes grol ba la: rang grol ngo shes kyi gdams ngag dgos: de la nges shes skye ba la: sems can rnams la snying rje dgos: nyams dang rtogs pa skye ba la: bla ma la gsol 'debs mos gus dgos: byin rlabs can gyi gsol 'debs la: nyid kyi rnam thar mdzad tshul la brten pa'i gsol 'debs zhig zhu lags: zhes zhus pas: gu ru'i zhal nas: nyon dang mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: spyir bud med kyi rigs la snying rje chung ba: mos gus med pa: mig ser che ba: 'khu ldog mang ba: gdug sems dang ser sna che ba: rigs drug rang chas su yod pa: rang sems kyi 'du shes gcod pa la: dad pa dang shes rab brtson 'grus gsum dgos pa 'di ltar: dad pa byas pas bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug: brtson 'grus byas pas 'du 'dzi'i bar chad bzlog: shes rab bskyed pas the tshom mdud pa grol: mos gus dang dad pa bskyed la gsol ba 'di ltar thob: ces gsungs nas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings khyab brdal pho brang nas: kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas he ru ka: snang stong dbyer med bde stong zag med sku: dang po'i sangs rgyas de la gsol ba 'debs: gzhal yas chen po rgya mtsho'i klong dkyil nas:

ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan steng du: legs 'khrungs 'chi med mtsho skyes rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: bde stong ting 'dzin brtan par byin gyis rlobs: zhing mchog dag pa o rgyan pho brang nas: rin chen nyi 'od gsal ba'i gdan steng na: khams gsum dbang bsdud pad+ma rgyal po la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: 'dzin pa rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod chen po nas: bam ro gsar rnying brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: rtsa rlung bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs: sku la rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas: dregs pa pho mo brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: rat+na thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: sems nyid chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: laṅka'i yul gyi pho brang chen po nas: rak+sha pho mo brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: zhen log mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: las rab rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas: dam sri pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: karma thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: lha srin dbang du 'du bar byin gyis rlobs: ma ga ta yi pho brang chen po nas: ma traṃ ru dra brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: bud+dha thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: mi 'gyur dbyings rig rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: bya khyung skye med rdzong gi gzhal yas nas: rin chen 'jigs med 'bar ba'i gdan steng du: shākya seng ge'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: rgyu 'bras dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: kun mkhyen rigs kyi dbyings chen pho brang nas: mkhas grub blo ldan mchog sred la gsol ba 'debs: yon tan lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: so sa ro gling tshal gyi gnas mchog nas: nyi ma gtod mnan rmongs pa'i mun sel ba: rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan khyed la gsol ba 'debs:

blo gros pad tshal rgyas par byin gyis rlobs: 'chi med tshe dbang gzhal yas chen po nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas sangs rgyas tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: za hor me ri 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: thabs kyi sprul pas 'gro don sna tshogs mdzad: pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs: rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi pho brang nas: mu stegs ma lus sprul pa'i stobs kyis bsgral: seng ge sgra sgrogs sku la gsol ba 'debs: ma rungs gdug pa 'dul bar byin gyis rlobs: log 'dren 'dul mdzad drag po'i pho brang nas: rdo rje gro lod sku la gsol ba 'debs: rang sems dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: brag dmar mchims phu dben pa'i ri khrod nas: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas lhun grub chos kyi pho brang nas: khri srong lde'u btsan lo paṇa mched lnga dang : rje 'bangs shes rab ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: snying thig bstan pa dar bar byin gyis rlobs: tsit+ta dung khang 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: yi dam zhi khro rang gsal la gsol ba 'debs: bar do rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs: khra mo brag gi sgrub pa'i gnas chen du: dam chos mkha' 'gro snying thig la gsol ba 'debs: tshig don mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs: bka' dang dam tshig gsang ba'i pho brang nas: sangs rgyas bstan srung dam can gter bdag la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: bar chad ma lus zhi bar mdzad du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par bsam: de'i ngang las sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la khrig ge: yengs med du rjen ne: 'dzin med du hril le:

rang babs su lhod de bzhag: yer gyis bslang : hril gyis mnan: de ltar mdzod: ces gsol 'debs brgyud bzhi ma 'di ni gter sgrom thod chung dkar po'i nang du: brag ri dung dkar 'dra ba'i 'og tu shing gter sbas: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: bka' rgya: dam rgya: gsang rgya: gter bdag seng gdong can la gtad: gter srung bdud rje 'bar ba'o: ༈ rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i gsol 'debs bzhugs: na mo/ rgyal ba'i mdzad pa dpag med nam mkha'i khyon// dus gsum du mar 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// sprul dang yang sprul rgyal sras nyi shu lnga// 'dir gshegs phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs// snang ba mtha' yas bde ba'i mkha' klong nas// spyan ras gzigs dbang gsal ba'i 'od stong shar// pad+ma 'byung gnas ma rig mun pa sel// sku gsum byin rlabs rtsa brgyud la phyag 'tshal// bsad dang gso ba'i grub pa mchog brnyes pa'i// mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal ma// nyi zer la chibs mkha' spyod grub pa thob// gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal// snang srid dbang bsdud rta skad phyogs bcur 'tsher// he ru ka sprul rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang*// snang srid ma mo bran khol pho nyar 'gyed// 'brog ban dpal gyi ye shes la phyag 'tshal// drag sngags grub pas lha srin bran du khol// sngags 'chang nus ldan dpal gyi seng ge dang*// ye shes spyan ldan sprul pas sa gsum khyab// mdo sngags mthar phyin bai ro la phyag 'tshal// 'jam dpal sprul pas mi g.yo ting 'dzin brnyes// chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang*// sgra tshad kun mkhyen rtogs pa mchog dang ldan// rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po la phyag 'tshal// rdzu 'phrul mchog ldan brag las bdud rtsi 'byin// dpal chen dzñā na ku ma ra dang ni// rlung ltar thogs med stong gsum khyab par nyul// nus ldan rdo rje bdud 'joms la phyag 'tshal// mkha' spyod gnas gshegs rdzu 'phrul cir yang ston// slob dpon chen po ye shes dbyangs dang ni// gdug pa'i gcan gzan khro gtum gnya' bar 'dzin// khrag 'thung sog po lha dpal la phyag 'tshal// mkha' la bya ltar lding zhing rlung ltar 'phyo// mkha' spyod sna nam ye shes dpal dang ni// phur pa'i las grub btab tshad myur du gum// bdud 'dul dpal gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// mi brjed gzungs thob theg dgu thugs la rdzogs// mkhan chen ldan ma rtse mang rdzu 'phrul dpal// mkhyen pa gnyis ldan gzhan gyi sems rgyud dgongs// lo chen ska ba dpal brtsegs la phyag 'tshal// chu bo gyen bzlog nyi zla gtod la mnan// grub thob rgyal po shud bu dpal seng dang*// 'dod yon zhen log ro langs gser du bsgyur// 'dod 'byung rgyal ba'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal// rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis mkha' spyod ma lus 'dzin// khye'u chung lo tsā sna tshogs zlos gar mkhan// ting 'dzin nus pas byang g.yag lho'i gcan 'gug

/dbang grub dran pa nam mkha' la phyag 'tshal// sa spyod grub pas chu la nya ltar 'dzul// 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug chos spyan ldan// rdo brag pha waṃ lcags sogs zan ltar gsol// rma thog rin chen mchog der la phyag 'tshal// ri brag dngos kun thogs med spyod pa mdzad// sa spyod grub thob dpal gyi rdo rje dang*// thog chen mda' ltar 'phen pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal// snang sems sgyu ma'i don rtogs rtsal rdzogs pas// brag la phur gdab sangs rgyas ye shes dang*// mkha' la skyil krung bzhugs shing snang srid gzigs// ting 'dzin rgyal ba byang chub la phyag 'tshal// ji snyed mkhyen cing grub pas sa gsum du// khyab par sprul mdzad rje 'bangs nyer lnga la// de ltar mos dang dad pas gsol btab mthus// lta ba klong chen rtogs pa mngon gyur zhing*// sgom pa nyi ma sprin bral ltar gsal ba// spyod pa spang blang rtsis gdab re dwogs bral// 'bras bu rin chen 'khrul med btsan sa zin// bskyed rdzogs gsang sngags nus pa'i rtsal rdzogs shing*// rdzu 'phrul du mas bdag gzhan don mdzad pa// grub chen nyer lnga'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces de ltar grub pa thob pa'i skyes mchog nyer lnga'i gsol 'debs nyung ngu zhig dgos zhes o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ mtsho gling gangs ri'i zhol tsit+ta bsgom pa'i ri khrod du stag sham rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// ༈ grub chen mchog ldan rdo rje'i rnam thar gsol 'debs mchog ldan lnga pa bzhugs so// ༈ bod 'dir 'gro ba'i don mdzad rin po che// zhing der sprul sku pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// gang de'i gsung 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa la// rtse gcig mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs// nub kyi phyogs su bde gshegs 'od dpag med// shar gyi phyogs su grub thob nyag se ba// dbus der 'dul ba 'od ces mi yi mgon// zhing 'dir mchog ldan rdo rje'i mtshan 'dzin pa'i// grub chen mchog ldan rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// sngon 'das dus su bde gshegs lha yi sras// pad+ma'i drung du chos blo mgon po mchog

/snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gter ston chen por sprul// da lta rgyal ba'i phrin las 'dzin byed pa'i// grub chen mchog ldan rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// rgya ston drung du dge slong grags 'bum pa// rgyal sras lung bstan las can 'gro ba'i mgon// thang stong rgyal pos mtshan gsol mchog ldan pa// dbang bskur lung bstan rnal 'byor chen por mdzad// grub chen mchog ldan rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// rgyal khams gling du mi smyon ro snyoms pa// las ldan rnams la chos kyis tshim par mdzad// bzang ngan kun la 'brel bzhag don dang ldan// grub thob chen po 'gran bral mi yi gzugs// grub chen mchog ldan rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen dang grub rtags bsam 'das ston mdzad cing*// rdo rje'i lus la skye 'chi 'jig med kyang*// rtag 'dzin sun 'byin snyung dang zhal gdams bzhag /'das tshul ston mdzad sku gdung ring bsrel sogs// 'gro ba'i don du ngo mtshar du ma bzhag /grub chen mchog ldan rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs// khyed la gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas// bde chen kun dga'i zhing der khyed kyi drung*// 'khor gyi thog mar bdag cag gyur nas kyang*// sprul pa'i stobs kyis 'khor ba dong sprugs shog / ces pa 'di ni bdag 'dra bsam gtan rdo rje ngas grub thob pa dag snang du mjal bas skyes rabs rnam thar la brten nas gsol 'debs smon lam rgyas 'debs bcas gdams phu tsan+dan ri khrod gangs kyi zhol rgya ston chos rje'i gzim skyil rgya gar khang bur bris pa'o/// / ༈ gter ston 'ja' tshon snying po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs 'ja' tshon bco lnga pa bzhugs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ rang bzhin rnam dag chos sku 'od dpag med// bde chen longs sku 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// bde gshegs kun 'dus sprul sku pad+ma 'byung*// ngo bo nyid sku rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon pa// rtag tu sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'dir bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub pa dang*// mthar thug kun bzang klong du grol bar shog

/ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas gdod ma'i mgon// lhun grub rang 'od sgyu 'phrul gang 'dul ston// sngon tshe bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i nang*// rgyal bu dbang po dpal zhes 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// shāka thub spyan sngar nam snying ko'u tam// grags ldan chos skyong gnya' khri btsan po dang*// o rgyan drung du nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang*// sgam po'i thugs sras gcer sgom 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// de nas rim bzhin dung mtsho ras pa dang*// chos dbyings dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// sangs rgyas sgom pa ras dkar thugs rje'i mtshan// mon gyi dung mtsho ras pa 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// de yi rnam 'phrul bsod nams rgyal po sogs// skye brgyud sprul brgyud yang brgyud bsam mi khyab// las lus ma yin sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can// dus gsum rgyal ba'i pho nya 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// slar yang kong yul nyang kha stod du 'khrungs// ngo mtshar ltas bzang sgra 'od zer dang bcas// skyes lo gsum nas 'bri klog rang bzhin mkhyen// rdo la phyag zhabs rjes bzhag 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// byis pa'i rtsed mo thams cad mtshams sgrub tshul// dbang bskur chos gsungs gtsug lag khang bzhengs zer// kun gyis ya mtshan mthong snang mang du byung*// sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad pa'i 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// bcu gcig lon tshe 'jig rten zhen pa log /'dus byas thams cad mi rtag sdug bsngal mthong*// 'gro ba'i nad sel gso rig slob gnyer mdzad// sman pa'i mchog gyur 'tsho byed 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// de tshe lha dang bla ma'i da la ni// dngos nyams rmi lam kun tu yang yang mjal// sgyu ma'i 'od zer nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar// dag snang phyogs med shar ba'i 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// nyer gcig len tshe mtshan ldan bla ma'i drung*// rab byung tshul khrims ngang tshul rgyan gyis mdzes// dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs rim gnyis gsan par mdzad// bstan rtsa shākya'i dge slong 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// zab khrid gdams pas rtsa thig rlung la 'bad// spros bral ngang nas 'od gsal ma bu 'dres// brag rtsa shing drung sa dbyibs ri sul du// dka' spyad bcud len mthar phyin 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// bskyed rdzogs dbyer med rang rig klong yangs nas// gsang spyod dmigs pas lha srin dam la btags// mi lo bcu dgu bug sgo 'dag sbyar mdzad// sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pa'i 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// smon lam dbang gis pad+ma'i zab gter bton// rmi lam sprul pas rnga yab gling du byon// gu ru pad+ma sgam po karma pas// byin brlabs dbang bskur gter ston 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skye 'gro'i dpal du shar// skal ldan las can chos bdag lag tu 'phrod// 'gro don bka' babs zab chos 'khor lo bskor// pad 'byung gnyis pa sngags 'chang 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// ma rig mun sel 'gro rnams bde la bkod// hor sog mtha' dmag 'khrug rtsod 'phral du bzlog

/char chu dus 'bebs lo 'bras phun sum tshogs// smon lam bsngo ba'i mkhan po 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs po dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// 'di nas tshe 'phos zangs mdog dpal ri ru// rigs kun bdag nyid sangs rgyas thod phreng rtsal// thugs dang dbyer med slar yang sprul zer 'khyug /mthar phyin 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas 'ja' tshon pa// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs//

rnam thar 'ja' tshon bco lnga'i tshigs bcad 'di// dad ldan skal ldan mon gyi bon po ba// shākya o rgyan chos dbang bskul ngor bris// dge bas 'gro kun smin grol sangs rgyas shog / ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ hrīḥ ma bcos lhun grub ka dag rang mdangs las// cir yang shar ba'i rig rtsal sgyu 'phrul ni// gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin bang ri ba// o rgyan las 'phro gling par gsol ba 'debs// dang po mdo rgyud man ngag legs par sbyangs// bar du bskyed rdzogs dbyer med sgrub pa btsug /yang dag don gyi rab 'byams bang ri ba// rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying por gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang pad+ma'i yang sprul dge sbyong tshul// bskal dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba'i dpal du shar// bdag 'dzin rū dra 'joms pa'i bang ri ba// sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag me 'bar la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// gnas skabs mthar thug dngos grub char 'bebs shing*// mkhyen brtse nus ldan 'ja' lus 'od phung gyur// bdag gzhan dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog / ces kong btsun de mos bskul nas rig 'dzin chen po rang gis mdzad pa'o// ༈ gu ru pad+ma'i rjes 'dzin du mos pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcer nyal mkhan gyi skyes rabs gsol 'debs tshigs bcad bco lnga pa bzhugs so/ kun bzang cho rol a li ka li'i gzugs// 'khrul bral chos nyid khyab brdal chos sku che// sna tshogs 'gro ba'i don mdzad sprul pa'i sku// rdo rje slob dpon zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 1) /sngon tshe dbang bskur gsang mtshan blo gros zhes// khye'u sngon po stag gi sham thabs can// rta mgrin dbang gis byin brlabs nus pa can// sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 2) /rdo rje gdan du bcom ldan spyan snga ru// khye'u spos 'dzin smra ba'i bshes gnyen te// shing gcig drung gnas stag gdan shing lo'i gos// yig drug smra ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

3) /o rgyan pho brang u pa ta yi bu// rgyal sras spyod pas gdul bya'i dus babs gzigs// rdo rje'i mtshon gyis bsgral nas smon lam mdzad// pad+ma'i smon 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 4) /li yul dga' ba'i tshal du smon lam can// slob dpon la dad bu mo badz+ra mtsho// me tog bcu gsum lhar phul yang dag bsngos// bsam rgu'i don grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 5) /bod yul bstan pa'i nyi 'od brdal ba'i tshe// sar gnas sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros mtshan// gu ru'i rjes 'dzin rta mgrin bka' babs shing*// ro langs gser bsgyur zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 6) /bal yul byang chub chen po'i bde chen grogs// rdo rje skyid dang mtsho zhes rdzu 'phrul can// gsang sngags smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// sgrol ma'i rang 'od zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 7) /zla 'od gzhon nu'i drung du gsal stong mtshan// rlung sems dbang thob snang ba sgyu mar rtogs// 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po mkhyen cing gzigs// sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 8) /zhang gi drung du 'dul ba'i 'od ces bya// dbang bzhi rdzogs shing lam 'byongs drod rtags brnyes// bka' 'gyur ma lus nyin zhag phrug rer bklags// ngag gi dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 9) /khams phyogs mdo smad gnas yul kun tu nyul// sa spyod grub pa'i dbang phyug zhig chen pa// phag mo rir bsgrubs bde chen dbang bsgyur zhing*// rnal 'byor ras chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 10) /thang stong rgyal po'i spyan sngar mchog ldan pa// mdo sngags glur blangs ngag gi rtsa mdud grol// gter la spyod cing 'byung ba lnga dbang bsgyur// grub chen rnal 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 11) /nyag pa'i phyogs su bon po nyi ma'i mtshan// bon nyid 'chad cing snang srid zas su za// bon sngags lag char thogs nas dam nyams bsgral// sngags bon rnal 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

12) /mdo smad las smon dag pa'i pho brang nas// zab lam don ldan tshe dbang rgyal po zhes// zab mo'i gter spyod dga' bzhi'i 'gros mchog ldan// sngags 'chang rnal 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 13) /'bri gung gdan sa chen po'i pho brang nas// rin chen mtshan can bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs// yang zab gter spyod zab mo'i don la 'jug /bslab gsum don ldan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 14) /khams kyi rat+na ka dang 'bri yi phyogs// lha pa chos 'byung thugs dgongs yangs pa'i mi// zab don dgongs khrol cho ga'i lag len mkhas// dbang don sngags mkhan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ 15) /de ltar dus gsum dus min sprul bsgyur rnams// las lus ma yin sgyu ma'i rang 'od las// da lta gdul bya'i mos blor tha dad pa'i// zab mo'i gter 'byin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag gzhan smin grol lam mkhan bla ma mchog /tshe rabs kun dang tshe rgyud thams cad du// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis// sa bcu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog / ces rnal 'byor pa bsam gtan rdo rje zhes gcer nyal 'phrad 'jog mkhan nga'i skyes rabs la brten pa'i gsol 'debs dgos zhes gso ba rig pa la mkhas pa'i sngags kyi ban+de o rgyan ye shes kyis yang yang bskul ba la brten nas tsit+ta snying gi ri sul du 'grub par sbyar ba'o// dge ba 'dis mtshon ma gyur rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog//
